title: XAI-Guided Fourier Domain Generalisation for Pure-Simulation Sim-to-Real Deep Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.16478v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Deep reinforcement learning has shown strong potential for vision-based autonomous driving, but policies trained in simulation often suffer severe performance degradation when deployed in the real world. Existing sim-to-real methods commonly address this gap through image-transfer-based domain adaptation or policy-agnostic domain randomisation. However, the former requires laborious acquisition of target-domain data and is often limited to the deployment domain, whereas the latter introduces unguided perturbations that may not reflect the underlying sim-to-real discrepancy, leading to suboptimal transfer performance. To overcome these limitations, we propose XFD, an explainable artificial intelligence (XAI)-guided Fourier domain generalisation framework for pure-simulation sim-to-real reinforcement learning. translated_title: 基于可解释人工智能引导的傅里叶域泛化用于纯仿真的仿真到真实深度强化学习
translated_abstract: 深度强化学习在基于视觉的自动驾驶中展现出强大潜力，但在仿真环境中训练的策略在部署到真实世界时往往会出现严重的性能下降。现有的仿真到真实方法通常通过基于图像迁移的域适应或与策略无关的域随机化来解决这一差距。然而，前者需要费力地获取目标域数据，且通常仅限于特定部署域；而后者引入的扰动缺乏引导，可能无法反映潜在的仿真到真实差异，从而导致次优的迁移性能。为克服这些局限性，我们提出了XFD，一种用于纯仿真到真实强化学习的可解释人工智能（XAI）引导的傅里叶域泛化框架。所提出的框架从仿真观测中提取可解释性归因图，并将这些归因转换为……
tldr: 提出XFD框架，利用可解释人工智能（XAI）从仿真观测中提取归因图来引导傅里叶域泛化，从而在不依赖真实目标域数据的情况下实现纯仿真到真实的深度强化学习迁移。
en_tdlr: Proposes XFD, an explainable AI-guided Fourier domain generalisation framework that leverages attribution maps extracted from simulated observations to guide domain perturbations, enabling pure-simulation sim-to-real deep reinforcement learning without target-domain data.
